description: 0.13.3 CHILFOS FIX03 over Lizalfos FIX05 0.12.5 (Lizalfos unchanged). The Chilfos (E_KK) fights with four learnable combos (one ends with a backstep, a real spear throw and a fast restore); fast double thrusts at x1.10; its spear never breaks when it blocks or parries; a raised guard blocks every frontal sword hit; it parries and counters. HP and posture are two independent ways to win: HP 0 kills it normally, hidden skills deal ordinary damage instead of an instant kill, and at 100 posture it staggers for 3 s: a new sword hit, Shield Attack then Helm Splitter, or B for Link's native Mortal Draw finishes it.
